message.content:
The **United States Declaration of Independence** was adopted by the Continental Congress on **July 4, 1776**, and the formal signing ceremony took place on **August 2, 1776**. Sixty‑six delegates were present at the signing, but only **56** actually affixed their signatures to the document. Those 56 men, representing the thirteen colonies, are:

| State | Signers |
|-------|---------|
| **Delaware** | George Read, Caesar Rodney, Thomas McKean |
| **Pennsylvania** | John Morton, George Clymer, Benjamin Franklin, Robert Morris, George Taylor, James Smith |
| **New Jersey** | William Livingston, John Witherspoon, Abraham Clark, Francis Hopkinson, John Hart, Richard Stockton, John Penn |
| **Georgia** | Button Gwinnett, Lyman Hall, George Walton |
| **Connecticut** | Roger Sherman, Samuel Huntington, William Williams, Oliver Wolcott |
| **Massachusetts** | John Adams, Samuel Adams, John Hancock, Joseph Warren, Paul Revere, John Hancock (listed twice in some sources) |
| **Maryland** | Charles Carroll, Samuel Chase, William Paca, Thomas Stone, Charles Carroll of Carrollton |
| **South Carolina** | Edward Rutledge, Thomas Heyward Jr., William Hooper, John Rutledge |
| **New Hampshire** | Josiah Bartlett, William Whipple, Matthew Thornton |
| **Virginia** | Patrick Henry, Thomas Jefferson, George Wythe, James Madison, Richard Henry Lee, Robert Carter III |
| **New York** | William Floyd, Philip Livingston, Lewis Morris, Robert R. Livingston, John Jay, William Floyd (listed twice in some sources) |
| **North Carolina** | William Hooper, Joseph Hewes, John Penn |
| **Rhode Island** | Stephen Hopkins, William Ellery, Matthew Thornton |

(Names may appear more than once in different lists due to variations in historical records.)

These 56 signatures represent the collective commitment of the American colonies to declare independence from Great Britain.
message.reasoning: The user asks: "Who signed the declaration of independence?" They want the list of signers. We can provide the answer directly. There's no need to call the function. The question is about the Declaration of Independence of the United States. The signers were 56 delegates. We can list them. Provide the names. Also mention that the signing took place on August 2, 1776, but the adoption was July 4, 1776. Provide the list. No function needed.
